observations: Photo 0 shows a single white game console placed on cardboard boxes, viewed from an angle; no brand/model text is legible on the unit itself.
Two boxed items labeled 'Wireless Controller' in red/white generic packaging sit next to the console - packaging style does not match official Sony DualShock retail boxes.
A UK three-pin power plug and cable are coiled on top of the console.
No power-on screen, serial number, rear port close-up, or UK receipt is visible in the single photo.
The console's color (white) and visible shape do not match the known PS4 Pro design, which Sony only released in black/jet-black finishes.

claims.evidence: photo 0 - console is white; Sony never released the PS4 Pro in white, only black/jet-black, suggesting this is a different PS4 variant (Slim/Fat).
